race.comment: VICTORY COMMAND (1) brings a strong profile after closing nicely for second at Dalby over 2000m, beaten just over a length, and the return to 1800m is a positive given his strong record around this trip. The failure two back at Eagle Farm is worth glazing over. WEEKEND ARTIST (4) is the main danger, having won at this track last start and already having the key recent head-to-head over ALL ABOUT ARTIE. He is in winning form and has the same rider back. ALL ABOUT ARTIE (8) was disappointing as favourite behind WEEKEND ARTIST, but his nose second at this venue the start prior keeps him firmly in calculations if he rebounds. ZWEIGELT (5) is lightly raced and comes off a well-supported Eagle Farm maiden win in Saturday company, though 1800m is a query.
